title: a16z Podcast: The Oral History Of TrialPay — Obstacles and Opportunities in Payments

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In this hallway-style conversation (originally recorded as a video), a16z general partner Alex Rampell and Terry Angelos.
reader_summary.overview: In this hallway-style conversation (originally recorded as a video), a16z general partner Alex Rampell and Terry Angelos, SVP of Commerce Solutions at Visa. The story begins with their serendipitous initial meeting twelve years ago; tracks the obstacles overcome, rise, and eventual acquisition of TrialPay (by Visa in 2015). How can a third party increase profits for all parties involved?

key_points.text: In this hallway-style conversation (originally recorded as a video), a16z general partner Alex Rampell and Terry Angelos, SVP of Commerce Solutions at Visa.
The story begins with their serendipitous initial meeting twelve years ago; tracks the obstacles overcome, rise.
And how can a payments startup make a splash in an industry dominated by a few well-known incumbents?
